data.name: Qassam
data.gender_notes: Qassam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who announces or proclaims something, often a military announcement or declaration of war. The name Qassam carries the meaning “announcer, proclaimer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qassam usually hope their child will grow to embody announcer, proclaimer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the importance of speaking truth and standing up for what is right, even in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Qassam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “announcer, proclaimer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qassam total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: قسام
in_arabic.meaning: القسام هو من يقسم ويوزع ويقسم الله تعالى على عباده رزقهم
in_arabic.long_meaning: القسام اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، وهو من يقسم ويوزع رزق عباده، ويقسم بينهم بالعدل والرحمة، كما جاء في القرآن الكريم: 'وَيَقْسِمُونَ مَرِزَاقَهُمْ تَقْسِيمًا' (الذاريات: 19)، ويشير إلى توزيع الله تعالى للرزق على عباده وفقًا لما يرى من المصلحة لهم

in_urdu.name: قسام
in_urdu.meaning: قسام وہ شخص ہے جو تقسیم کرتا ہے اور لوگوں میں بانٹتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: قسام اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو اپنے عباد میں رزق تقسیم کرنے والا ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن مجید میں ہے: 'وَيَقْسِمُونَ مَرِزَاقَهُمْ تَقْسِيمًا' (الذاريات: 19)، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں مقبول ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی رحمت اور عدل کے ساتھ رزق کی تقسیم

in_hindi.name: क़ास्सम
in_hindi.meaning: क़ास्सम वह व्यक्ति है जो बाँटता और वितरण करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ास्सम अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जो अपने अनुयायियों के बीच रिज़्क बांटने वाला है, जैसा कि कुरआन में कहा गया है: 'وَيَقْسِمُونَ مَرِزَاقَهُمْ تَقْسِيمًا' (الذاريات: 19)। यह नाम हिंदू-मुस्लिम परंपरा में प्रसिद्ध है और इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह की दया और न्याय के साथ रिज़्क की बंटवारा

in_pashto.name: قسّام
in_pashto.meaning: قسّام هغه څوک دی چی تقسیم کوی او ویش کوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: قسّام د الله تعالیٰ له ښو نومونو څخه یو دی، هغه خپل بندګانو ته روزګار تقسیم کوونکی دی، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کریم کې راغلي: 'وَيَقْسِمُونَ مَرِزَاقَهُمْ تَقْسِيمًا' (الذاريات: 19)، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مشهور دی او معنی یې د الله تعالیٰ د رحمت او عدالت سره د روزګار تقسیم دی

in_english.name: Qassam
in_english.meaning: Qassam means one who divides, distributes, or apportions
in_english.long_meaning: Qassam is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the One who distributes and apportions sustenance among His servants. It is derived from the Arabic root 'q-s-m' which implies division, distribution, or apportionment. In the Quran, it is mentioned as 'وَيَقْسِمُونَ مَرِزَاقَهُمْ تَقْسِيمًا' (الذاريات: 19), signifying the distribution of sustenance by Allah. The name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the attribute of Allah's mercy and justice in providing for His creation

data.cultural_impact: The name "Qassam" is significantly associated with the Palestinian armed resistance movement, Hamas. One of its most renowned martyr commanders, Yahya Ayyash, adopted the name Khalid Islambani Al-Qassam as a nom de guerre in honor of Izz Al-Din Al-Qassam, the founder of the military wing of the Islamic Brotherhood in 1935 in Palestine. Al-Qassam's guerrilla tactics against British rule in Palestine were instrumental in inspiring the modern Palestinian resistance movement and the name has since come to symbolize militant resistance in Palestine.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Qassam" resurfaces in Islamic history with Saint Izz Al-Din Al-Qassam, a Sufi mystic who lived during the medieval Islamic period in Palestine. He was known for his rigorous spiritual practices and audacious roars that disrupted the power of the oppressors, which was said to manifest God's divine power against injustice. Al-Qassam was also an advocate for social justice and maintained deep respect for the physical reality of life; he was never deterred from spiritual pursuits by worldly circumstances. The spiritual significance of the name "Qassam" is thus that of a fearless proclaimer of truth, often against rulers and oppressive administrations, and a passionate advocate for social justice and spiritual realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "announcer, proclaimer" symbolizes One who announces or proclaims something, often a military announcement or declaration of war. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qassam serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of announcer, proclaimer.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibrahim Abu al-Qassim al-Khalil (1892-1949) was an influential Palestinian Islamic scholar, religious leader, and political figure. He is best known for his role in the creation and leadership of the Islamic Resistance Movement, or Hamas, in the late 1980s. The name 'Qassam' is believed to be derived from the Arabic word 'qassamah' meaning 'to thunder', reflecting the militant and revolutionary spirit of the movement.

Ahmad Amin al-Husseini (1895-1974) was a Palestinian Arab nationalist leader and Grand Mufti of Jerusalem, who collaborated with the Nazis during World War II. The name 'Qassam' is also associated with him, as he led the Arab Revolt against the British Mandate of Palestine in 1936, which was known as the 'Qassam Intifada' due to the use of bombings and shootings as tactics.
historical_references.context: Arab Revolt against British Mandate of Palestine

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Qassam' is widely recognized as the name of a militant group, Hamas' military wing, in the Gaza Strip. They have gained notoriety for their frequent rocket launchings into Israeli territory, which contributes to the ongoing conflict between the two regions. The name 'Qassam' has trended recently on social media and news outlets following escalations in violence and rocket attacks, with many expressing their views and opinions on the situation.
